title: After the Japanese Derby: Positive Words

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Pant, huff, wheeze…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Well… That didn't go so well…

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Wow, that was such a heated race. I've gotta say I didn't see that ending coming, though.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Look over there! It's Mihono Bourbon and Rice Shower!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Rice.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: You've gotten much better since the Satsuki Sho. I've been watching you and I've certainly felt your improvement.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: But I'm going to win the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The crowd goes wild at their conversation.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: So Rice Shower has been chasing Bourbon all this time? They both had a great race!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: The Kikuka Sho is going to be a long-distance showdown! I can't wait to see how Rice Shower does!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All eyes in Tokyo Racecourse are on the two of them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser, on the other hand…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Aghhh, that was sooo close.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: No. You know what? I'm really frustrated!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser is always going for gold, but she was exceptionally motivated for her once-in-a-lifetime chance at the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I mean, there's nothing special about me at all! I'm ordinary! I'm nobody!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But… even if that's true… I still care about winning.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm the same as everyone else. If it's not first place, I don't need it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …I admire her passion, but in reality, you can't expect things to always go your way.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: This was a race I'll never get another chance at, so I wanted to win it sooo badly.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: And that's… that's exactly why…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser hangs her head and clenches her fists, shoulders shaking…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As if awaiting impending tears, the cameras focus in on her, but…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: The most important thing is what is next! Whatever it is!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her head snaps back up, and she's wearing that same bright expression everyone knows so well.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I've still got next time! That's why I'm gonna learn from my mistakes and train as hard as I can!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hey! Did you see Matikanetannhauser's press conference?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I did! I lost today too, but it made me feel better.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hehe. When she was all like, "whatever it is!"—I really felt that! I wanna be able to say things like that too.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Eek, how embarrassing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser's optimism and cheerful words touch the hearts of many.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Next up is the Kikuka Sho. As always, we're aiming to win.
